people.name: Adoni-bezek
people.description: The king in Bezek whose thumbs and great toes Judah cut off, as he had done to threescore and ten kings; he died at Jerusalem (Judges 1:5-7)

people.name: Asherites
people.description: The children of Asher, who dwelt among the Canaanites (Judges 1:31-32)

people.name: Eglon

people.name: Benjamites
people.description: The men of the tribe of Benjamin (Judges 3:15, 19:16, 20:35)

people.name: Ehud

people.description: The father of Ehud, a Benjamite (Judges 3:15)

people.name: Anath
people.description: The father of Shamgar (Judges 3:31, 5:6)

people.name: Shamgar
people.description: The son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad; he also delivered Israel (Judges 3:31, 5:6)

people.name: Jabin

people.name: Deborah
people.description: A prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, who judged Israel and sang with Barak (Judges 4:4-14, 5:1-15)

people.description: The husband of Deborah the prophetess (Judges 4:4)

people.name: Abinoam
people.description: The father of Barak (Judges 4:6, 5:1)

people.name: Barak

people.name: Heber
people.description: The Kenite, of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, husband of Jael (Judges 4:11, 4:17)

people.name: Jael
people.description: The wife of Heber the Kenite, who slew Sisera with a nail of the tent; "Blessed above women shall Jael ... be" (Judges 4:17-22, 5:24-27)

people.name: Gideon

people.name: Joash
people.description: The Abi-ezrite, the father of Gideon; he would not give up his son to the men of the city (Judges 6:11, 6:29-31, 8:32)

people.name: Phurah
people.description: Gideon's servant, who went down with him to the host of Midian (Judges 7:10-11)

people.name: Oreb
people.description: A prince of the Midianites, slain upon the rock Oreb (Judges 7:25, 8:3)

people.name: Zeeb

people.name: Zalmunna

people.name: Zebah

people.name: Abimelech

"Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab"

"whom she bare unto Saul"

people.name: Ucal

people.name: Shulamite
people.description: "Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee" (Song of Solomon 6:13)

people.name: Shear-jashub

people.description: Whose son Rezin and Pekah said they would "set a king in the midst" of Judah (Isaiah 7:6)

people.name: Maher-shalal-hash-baz

people.name: Jeberechiah
people.description: The father of Zechariah (Isaiah 8:2)

people.name: Uriah
people.description: "Uriah the priest", whom Isaiah took with Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah as "faithful witnesses to record" (Isaiah 8:2)

people.name: Zechariah
people.description: The son of Jeberechiah, whom Isaiah took with Uriah the priest as "faithful witnesses to record" (Isaiah 8:2)

people.name: Pharaoh

people.description: King of Assyria, who sent Tartan unto Ashdod (Isaiah 20:1)

people.name: Dedanim

people.name: Sabeans

people.name: Hilkiah

people.name: Immer
people.description: The priest, father of Pashur (Jeremiah 20:1)

people.name: Pashur
people.description: The son of Immer the priest, chief governor in the house of the Lord, who smote Jeremiah and put him in the stocks; "The Lord hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magor-missabib" (Jeremiah 20:1-6)

people.name: Maaseiah
people.description: The priest, father of Zephaniah (Jeremiah 21:1, 29:25, 37:3)

people.name: Zephaniah

people.name: Achbor
people.description: The father of Elnathan (Jeremiah 26:22, 36:12)

people.name: Elnathan
people.description: The son of Achbor, whom Jehoiakim sent into Egypt; one of the princes who made intercession that the king would not burn the roll (Jeremiah 26:22, 36:12, 36:25)

people.name: Shaphan

people.name: Baruch
people.description: The son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, who wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the Lord upon a roll of a book, and read them in the house of the Lord; "thy life will I give unto thee for a prey" (Jeremiah 32:12-16, 36:4-32, 43:3-6, 45:1-5)

people.name: Mary
people.description: "Mary the wife of Cleophas", who stood by the cross of Jesus (John 19:25)

people.name: Joseph
people.description: "Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus", appointed with Matthias when they chose one to take Judas's part (Acts 1:23)

people.name: Matthias
people.description: Chosen by lot in the room of Judas, "and he was numbered with the eleven apostles" (Acts 1:23-26)

people.name: Alexander
people.description: One "of the kindred of the high priest", gathered with Annas and Caiaphas against Peter and John (Acts 4:6)

people.name: John
people.description: One "of the kindred of the high priest", gathered with Annas and Caiaphas against Peter and John (Acts 4:6)

people.name: Barnabas
people.description: "Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus"; "a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith", who went with Paul (Acts 4:36, 11:24, 13:2)

tribe.note: "A Levite, and of the country of Cyprus"

people.name: Ananias
people.description: "A certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession, and kept back part of the price"; he "fell down, and gave up the ghost" (Acts 5:1-5)

people.name: Sapphira
people.description: The wife of Ananias, privy to his keeping back part of the price; "Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost" (Acts 5:1-10)

people.name: Gamaliel
people.description: "A Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people"; Paul was brought up "at the feet of Gamaliel" (Acts 5:34, 22:3)

people.name: Theudas
people.description: Who rose up "boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain" (Acts 5:36)

people.name: Judas
people.description: "Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing", who "drew away much people after him: he also perished" (Acts 5:37)

people.name: Nicanor
people.description: One of the seven chosen to serve tables (Acts 6:5)

people.name: Nicolas
people.description: One of the seven chosen to serve tables, "a proselyte of Antioch" (Acts 6:5)

people.name: Parmenas
people.description: One of the seven chosen to serve tables (Acts 6:5)

people.name: Philip
people.description: One of the seven "men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom" chosen to serve tables; he preached Christ in Samaria and baptized the eunuch; "Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven", who had "four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy" (Acts 6:3-5, 8:5-40, 21:8-9)

people.name: Prochorus
people.description: One of the seven chosen to serve tables (Acts 6:5)

people.name: Stephen
people.description: "A man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost", one of the seven; stoned by the council, "calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit" (Acts 6:5, 7:59)

people.name: Timon
people.description: One of the seven chosen to serve tables (Acts 6:5)

people.name: Alexandrians
people.description: Of the synagogue which disputed with Stephen (Acts 6:9)

people.name: Cyrenians
people.description: Of the synagogue which disputed with Stephen (Acts 6:9)

people.name: Libertines
people.description: "The synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines", which disputed with Stephen (Acts 6:9)

people.name: Paul
people.description: "Saul, (who also is called Paul,)" a young man at whose feet the witnesses laid their clothes; converted on the way to Damascus, "a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles"; "a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel" (Acts 7:58, 9:15, 13:9, 22:3)

tribe.note: "For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin"

nation.note: "I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus"; "I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus"

people.name: Simon
people.description: "A certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria"; he offered the apostles money for the Holy Ghost (Acts 8:9-24)

people.name: Candace
people.description: "Candace queen of the Ethiopians", whose eunuch had "the charge of all her treasure" (Acts 8:27)

people.name: Ananias
people.description: "A certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias", sent to put his hands on Saul; "a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there" (Acts 9:10-17, 22:12)

people.name: Judas
people.description: In whose house in the street called Straight, in Damascus, Saul was found (Acts 9:11)

people.name: Eneas
people.description: "A certain man named Eneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy", healed at Lydda (Acts 9:33-34)

people.name: Tabitha
people.description: "A certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds"; Peter raised her at Joppa (Acts 9:36-41)

people.name: Simon
people.description: "One Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side" in Joppa, with whom Peter tarried many days (Acts 9:43, 10:6, 10:32)

people.name: Cornelius
people.description: "A centurion of the band called the Italian band, a devout man, and one that feared God with all his house" (Acts 10:1-2)

people.name: Christians
people.description: "The disciples were called Christians first in Antioch"; "Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian" (Acts 11:26, 26:28)

people.name: Agabus
people.description: A prophet who "signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world", and bound his own hands and feet with Paul's girdle (Acts 11:28, 21:10-11)

people.name: Claudius
people.description: "Claudius Cesar", in whose days the dearth came; he "had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome" (Acts 11:28, 18:2)

people.name: Herod
people.description: "Herod the king", who "killed James the brother of John with the sword" and took Peter; arrayed in royal apparel, he made an oration, "and immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost" (Acts 12:1-23)

children.note: King Agrippa of Acts 25-26 is the son of the king Agrippa whose death Acts 12 tells

sources.title: Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 19.9.1 (Whiston): "And thus did king Agrippa depart this life. But he left behind him a son, Agrippa by name ... and three daughters; one of which, Bernice ... the other two, Mariamne and Drusilla"

children.note: Bernice, who came with king Agrippa, is a daughter of the same king

sources.title: Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 19.9.1 (Whiston): "three daughters; one of which, Bernice"

children.note: Drusilla the Jewess, the wife of Felix, is a daughter of the same king and a sister of king Agrippa

sources.title: Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 19.9.1 (Whiston): "the other two, Mariamne and Drusilla"
Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 20.7.2 (Whiston): "While Felix was procurator of Judea, he saw this Drusilla, and fell in love with her"

line.note: "Herod the king" of Acts 12 is the king Agrippa of Josephus, whose death at Cæsarea he tells the same way; that Agrippa was a grandson of Herod the Great, the son of his son Aristobulus

sources.title: Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 19.8.2 (Whiston): "presently his flatterers cried out ... that he was a god"
Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 18.5.4 (Whiston): "their father, Agrippa, was brought up with his other brethren, Herod and Aristobulus, for these were also the sons of the son of Herod the Great"

people.name: John
people.description: "John, whose surname was Mark", who went with Barnabas and Saul, and departed from them at Perga; Barnabas "took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus" (Acts 12:12, 12:25, 13:5, 13:13, 15:37-39)

mother.note: "Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark"

people.name: Mary
people.description: "Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying" (Acts 12:12)

children.note: "Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark"

people.name: Rhoda
people.description: "A damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda", who knew Peter's voice (Acts 12:13-14)

people.name: James
people.description: The James to whom Peter sent word when he was delivered out of prison, who gave sentence at the council in Jerusalem, and with whom Paul went in unto the elders: "Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren" (Acts 12:17, 15:13-21, 21:18)

people.name: Blastus
people.description: "The king's chamberlain", whom they of Tyre and Sidon made their friend (Acts 12:20)

people.name: Lucius
people.description: "Lucius of Cyrene", one of the prophets and teachers at Antioch (Acts 13:1)

people.name: Manaen
people.description: One of the prophets and teachers at Antioch, "which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch" (Acts 13:1)

people.name: Simeon
people.description: "Simeon that was called Niger", one of the prophets and teachers at Antioch (Acts 13:1)

people.name: Elymas
people.description: "A certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus"; "Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation)", smitten blind (Acts 13:6-11)

people.name: Sergius Paulus
people.description: "The deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man", who believed (Acts 13:7, 13:12)

people.name: Judas
people.description: "Judas surnamed Barsabas", one of the "chief men among the brethren", a prophet, sent with Silas to Antioch with the letter of the council (Acts 15:22-32)

people.name: Silas
people.description: One of the "chief men among the brethren", a prophet, whom Paul chose; with Paul he was beaten and laid in the stocks at Philippi (Acts 15:22, 15:32, 15:40, 16:19-25)

people.name: Timotheus
people.description: "A certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek": him Paul circumcised (Acts 16:1-3)

line.note: "Thy grandmother Lois"

people.name: Lydia
people.description: "A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened"; she was baptized, and her household (Acts 16:14-15, 16:40)

people.name: Jason
people.description: Who received Paul and Silas at Thessalonica; the Jews "assaulted the house of Jason", and took security of him (Acts 17:5-9)

people.name: Epicureans
people.description: "Certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks" (Acts 17:18)

people.name: Stoicks
people.description: "Certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks" (Acts 17:18)

people.name: Athenians
people.description: "All the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing" (Acts 17:21)

people.name: Damaris
people.description: "A woman named Damaris", who believed at Athens (Acts 17:34)

people.name: Dionysius
people.description: "Dionysius the Areopagite", who clave unto Paul and believed (Acts 17:34)

people.name: Aquila
people.description: "A certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla"; of the same craft, tentmakers (Acts 18:2-3, 18:18, 18:26)

nation.note: "A certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus"

people.name: Priscilla
people.description: The wife of Aquila, who with him "expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly" (Acts 18:2, 18:26)

people.name: Justus
people.description: "A certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue" at Corinth (Acts 18:7)

people.name: Corinthians
people.description: "Many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized" (Acts 18:8)

people.name: Crispus
people.description: "The chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house" (Acts 18:8)

people.name: Gallio
people.description: "The deputy of Achaia"; "and Gallio cared for none of those things" (Acts 18:12-17)

people.name: Sosthenes
people.description: "The chief ruler of the synagogue", beaten before the judgment seat (Acts 18:17)

people.name: Apollos
people.description: "A certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures" (Acts 18:24, 19:1)

nation.note: "A certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria"

people.name: Tyrannus
people.description: In whose school Paul disputed daily (Acts 19:9)

people.name: Sceva
people.description: "A Jew, and chief of the priests", whose seven sons the evil spirit overcame (Acts 19:14-16)

nation.note: "Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests"

people.name: Erastus
people.description: One of them that ministered unto Paul, sent with Timotheus into Macedonia (Acts 19:22)

people.name: Demetrius
people.description: "A silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana", who stirred up the craftsmen against Paul (Acts 19:24-38)

people.name: Ephesians
people.description: "Great is Diana of the Ephesians"; "Trophimus an Ephesian" (Acts 19:28, 21:29)

people.name: Aristarchus
people.description: One of "Paul's companions in travel"; "a Macedonian of Thessalonica" (Acts 19:29, 20:4, 27:2)

people.name: Gaius
people.description: One of "Paul's companions in travel", a man of Macedonia, caught by the multitude at Ephesus (Acts 19:29)

people.name: Alexander
people.description: Drawn out of the multitude at Ephesus, "the Jews putting him forward"; he "would have made his defence unto the people" (Acts 19:33-34)

nation.note: "But when they knew that he was a Jew"

people.name: Gaius
people.description: "Gaius of Derbe", who accompanied Paul into Asia (Acts 20:4)

people.name: Secundus
people.description: One of the Thessalonians who accompanied Paul into Asia (Acts 20:4)

people.name: Sopater
people.description: "Sopater of Berea", who accompanied Paul into Asia (Acts 20:4)

people.name: Thessalonians
people.description: "Of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus" (Acts 20:4)

people.name: Trophimus
people.description: Of Asia, "an Ephesian", whom the Jews supposed Paul had brought into the temple (Acts 20:4, 21:29)

people.name: Tychicus
people.description: Of Asia; he accompanied Paul (Acts 20:4)

people.name: Eutychus
people.description: "A certain young man named Eutychus", who fell from the third loft and was taken up dead; "they brought the young man alive" (Acts 20:9-12)

people.name: Mnason
people.description: "One Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge" (Acts 21:16)

people.name: Ananias
people.description: "The high priest Ananias", who commanded them to smite Paul on the mouth, and went down to Cesarea against him (Acts 23:2, 24:1)

people.name: Felix
people.description: "The most excellent governor Felix", who heard Paul at Cesarea and trembled; he left Paul bound (Acts 23:24-26, 24:25-27)

people.name: Claudius Lysias
people.description: The chief captain at Jerusalem, who rescued Paul and sent him to Felix: "Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting" (Acts 21:31-33, 23:26)

people.name: Tertullus
people.description: "A certain orator named Tertullus", who informed the governor against Paul (Acts 24:1-8)

people.name: Nazarenes
people.description: "A ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes" (Acts 24:5)

people.name: Drusilla
people.description: Felix's "wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess" (Acts 24:24)

father.note: Drusilla the Jewess, the wife of Felix, is a daughter of the same king and a sister of king Agrippa

sources.title: Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 19.9.1 (Whiston): "the other two, Mariamne and Drusilla"
Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 20.7.2 (Whiston): "While Felix was procurator of Judea, he saw this Drusilla, and fell in love with her"

nation.note: "His wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess"

people.name: Festus
people.description: "Porcius Festus came into Felix' room"; to him Paul said, "I appeal unto Cesar" (Acts 24:27, 25:11-12)

people.name: Agrippa
people.description: "King Agrippa", who came with Bernice to Cesarea to salute Festus and heard Paul: "Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian" (Acts 25:13, 26:28)

father.note: King Agrippa of Acts 25-26 is the son of the king Agrippa whose death Acts 12 tells

sources.title: Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 19.9.1 (Whiston): "And thus did king Agrippa depart this life. But he left behind him a son, Agrippa by name ... and three daughters; one of which, Bernice ... the other two, Mariamne and Drusilla"

people.name: Bernice
people.description: Who came to Cesarea with king Agrippa "with great pomp" (Acts 25:13, 25:23, 26:30)

father.note: Bernice, who came with king Agrippa, is a daughter of the same king

sources.title: Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews 19.9.1 (Whiston): "three daughters; one of which, Bernice"

people.name: Julius
people.description: "A centurion of Augustus' band", who "courteously entreated Paul" (Acts 27:1-3, 27:43)

people.name: Macedonians
people.description: "One Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica" (Acts 27:2); "Aman, a Macedonian, the son of Amadatha" (Esther 16:10)

people.name: Publius
people.description: "The chief man of the island", whose father Paul healed (Acts 28:7-8)

people.name: Phebe
people.description: "Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea"; "she hath been a succourer of many" (Romans 16:1-2, 16:27)

people.name: Epenetus
people.description: "My wellbeloved Epenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ" (Romans 16:5)

people.name: Mary
people.description: "Mary, who bestowed much labour on us" (Romans 16:6)

people.name: Andronicus
people.description: Saluted with Junia: "my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles" (Romans 16:7)

people.name: Junia
people.description: Saluted with Andronicus: "my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles" (Romans 16:7)

people.name: Amplias
people.description: "Amplias my beloved in the Lord" (Romans 16:8)

people.name: Stachys
people.description: "Stachys my beloved" (Romans 16:9)

people.name: Urbane
people.description: "Urbane, our helper in Christ" (Romans 16:9)

people.name: Apelles
people.description: "Apelles approved in Christ" (Romans 16:10)

people.name: Aristobulus
people.description: "Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household" (Romans 16:10)

people.name: Herodion
people.description: "Herodion my kinsman" (Romans 16:11)

people.name: Narcissus
people.description: "Them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord" (Romans 16:11)

people.name: Persis
people.description: "The beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord" (Romans 16:12)

people.name: Tryphena
people.description: Saluted with Tryphosa, "who labour in the Lord" (Romans 16:12)

people.name: Tryphosa
people.description: Saluted with Tryphena, "who labour in the Lord" (Romans 16:12)

people.name: Rufus
people.description: "Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine" (Romans 16:13)

people.name: Asyncritus
people.description: Saluted at Rome (Romans 16:14)

people.name: Hermas
people.description: Saluted at Rome (Romans 16:14)

people.name: Hermes
people.description: Saluted at Rome (Romans 16:14)

people.name: Patrobas
people.description: Saluted at Rome (Romans 16:14)

people.name: Phlegon
people.description: Saluted at Rome (Romans 16:14)

people.name: Julia
people.description: Saluted at Rome (Romans 16:15)

people.name: Nereus
people.description: "Nereus, and his sister" (Romans 16:15)

people.name: Olympas
people.description: Saluted at Rome (Romans 16:15)

people.name: Philologus
people.description: Saluted at Rome (Romans 16:15)

people.name: Jason
people.description: "Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen" (Romans 16:21)

people.name: Lucius
people.description: "Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen" (Romans 16:21)

people.name: Sosipater
people.description: "Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen" (Romans 16:21)

people.name: Tertius
people.description: "I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord" (Romans 16:22)

people.name: Erastus
people.description: "Erastus the chamberlain of the city" (Romans 16:23)

people.name: Gaius
people.description: "Gaius mine host, and of the whole church" (Romans 16:23)

people.name: Quartus
people.description: "Quartus a brother" (Romans 16:23)

people.name: Sosthenes
people.description: "Sosthenes our brother", named with Paul in the greeting (1 Corinthians 1:1)

people.name: Chloe
people.description: "Them which are of the house of Chloe", who declared the contentions at Corinth (1 Corinthians 1:11)

people.name: Gaius
people.description: Whom Paul baptized at Corinth: "I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius" (1 Corinthians 1:14)

people.name: Stephanas
people.description: "The house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia", whose household Paul baptized (1 Corinthians 1:16, 16:15-17, 16:24)

people.name: James
people.description: "After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles" (1 Corinthians 15:7)

people.name: Achaicus
people.description: "I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus" (1 Corinthians 16:17, 16:24)

people.name: Fortunatus
people.description: "I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus" (1 Corinthians 16:17, 16:24)

people.name: Silvanus
people.description: Who preached the Son of God among the Corinthians with Paul and Timotheus (2 Corinthians 1:19)

people.name: Titus
people.description: "My brother", "my partner and fellowhelper concerning you"; Paul went up to Jerusalem with Barnabas, "and took Titus with me also", who "being a Greek" was not compelled to be circumcised (2 Corinthians 2:13, 8:23; Galatians 2:1-3)

nation.note: "Titus, who was with me, being a Greek"

people.name: Aretas
people.description: "Aretas the king", under whom the governor of Damascus kept the city to apprehend Paul (2 Corinthians 11:32)

people.name: Damascenes
people.description: "The city of the Damascenes" (2 Corinthians 11:32)

people.name: Luke
people.description: "Luke, the beloved physician"; "Only Luke is with me"; one of Paul's fellowlabourers; by "Titus and Lucas" the second epistle to the Corinthians was written (Colossians 4:14; 2 Timothy 4:11; Philemon 1:24; 2 Corinthians 13:14, subscription)

people.name: Galatians
people.description: "O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you" (Galatians 3:1, 6:18); conquered by the Romans, who "brought them under tribute" (1 Maccabees 8:2)

people.name: Epaphroditus
people.description: "Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants" (Philippians 2:25, 4:18, 4:23)

people.name: Euodias
people.description: "I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord"; "those women which laboured with me in the gospel" (Philippians 4:2-3)

people.name: Syntyche
people.description: "I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord"; "those women which laboured with me in the gospel" (Philippians 4:2-3)

people.name: Clement
people.description: One of Paul's fellowlabourers, "whose names are in the book of life" (Philippians 4:3)

people.name: Philippians
people.description: "Ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel" (Philippians 4:15, 4:23)

people.name: Epaphras
people.description: "Our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ"; "who is one of you"; Paul's "fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus" (Colossians 1:7, 4:12; Philemon 1:23)

people.name: Scythian
people.description: "Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all" (Colossians 3:11)

people.name: Onesimus
people.description: "A faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you"; "my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds", sent back to Philemon "not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved" (Colossians 4:9; Philemon 1:10-16)

people.name: Marcus
people.description: "Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas"; one of Paul's fellowlabourers (Colossians 4:10; Philemon 1:24)

people.name: Justus
people.description: "Jesus, which is called Justus", one of them "of the circumcision" that were Paul's fellowworkers (Colossians 4:11)

people.name: Demas
people.description: One of Paul's fellowlabourers, who greeted the Colossians; "Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world" (Colossians 4:14; Philemon 1:24; 2 Timothy 4:10)

people.name: Nymphas
people.description: "Nymphas, and the church which is in his house" (Colossians 4:15)

people.name: Laodiceans
people.description: "The church of the Laodiceans" (Colossians 4:16)

people.name: Archippus
people.description: "Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord"; "Archippus our fellowsoldier" (Colossians 4:17; Philemon 1:2)

people.name: Colossians
people.description: To whom the epistle was "Written from Rome ... by Tychicus and Onesimus" (Colossians 4:18, subscription)

people.name: Alexander
people.description: "Of whom is Hymeneus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme" (1 Timothy 1:20)

people.name: Hymeneus
people.description: "Of whom is Hymeneus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme"; "Hymeneus and Philetus; who concerning the truth have erred" (1 Timothy 1:20; 2 Timothy 2:17-18)

people.name: Eunice
people.description: Timothy's mother, in whom the unfeigned faith dwelt (2 Timothy 1:5)

children.note: "Thy mother Eunice"

people.name: Ecanus
people.description: One of the five "ready to write swiftly" whom Esdras took with him (2 Esdras 14:24)

people.name: Sarea
people.description: One of the five "ready to write swiftly" whom Esdras took with him (2 Esdras 14:24)

people.name: Selemia
people.description: One of the five "ready to write swiftly" whom Esdras took with him (2 Esdras 14:24)

people.name: Carmanians
people.description: "The Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood" (2 Esdras 15:30)

people.name: Aduel
people.description: In the line of Tobit, the son of Gabael, father of Ananiel (Tobit 1:1)

people.name: Ananiel
people.description: In the line of Tobit, the son of Aduel, father of Tobiel (Tobit 1:1)

people.name: Asael
people.description: Of whose seed was Tobit (Tobit 1:1)

people.name: Gabael
people.description: In the line of Tobit, father of Aduel, "of the seed of Asael" (Tobit 1:1)

line.note: "of the seed of Asael"

people.name: Tobiel
people.description: The father of Tobit, the son of Ananiel (Tobit 1:1)

people.name: Tobit
people.description: "Tobit, son of Tobiel", of the tribe of Nephthali, led captive to Nineve in the time of Enemessar; he did many almsdeeds and buried the dead, was blinded, and was healed by Raphael (Tobit 1:1-3, 2:10, 11:7-13)

partners.note: "I married Anna of mine own kindred"

siblings.note: "my brother Anael"

people.name: Enemessar
people.description: King of the Assyrians, in whose time Tobit was led captive; Tobit was his purveyor; Sennacherib his son reigned in his stead (Tobit 1:2, 1:13-15)

children.note: "Enemessar was dead, Sennacherib his son reigned in his stead"

people.name: Debora
people.description: Tobit's "father's mother", who commanded him to give the third tenth (Tobit 1:8)

children.note: "Debora my father's mother"

people.name: Anna
people.description: Tobit's wife, "of mine own kindred", mother of Tobias (Tobit 1:9, 2:1, 2:11, 14:12)

partners.note: "I married Anna of mine own kindred"

people.name: Tobias
people.description: The son of Tobit and Anna, who went with Raphael to Rages and took Sara the daughter of Raguel to wife (Tobit 1:9, 5:1-17, 7:13, 14:12-14)

partners.note: "gave her to be wife to Tobias"

people.name: Gabael
people.description: Of Rages in Media, with whom Tobit left ten talents of silver in trust; Tobias and Raphael fetched it (Tobit 1:14, 4:1, 4:20, 9:2-5)

father.note: "Gabael the son of Gabrias" (4:20); 1:14 calls him "the brother of Gabrias"

people.name: Gabrias
people.description: Named with Gabael, with whom Tobit left ten talents at Rages (Tobit 1:14, 4:20)

children.note: "Gabael the son of Gabrias" (4:20); 1:14 calls him "the brother of Gabrias"

people.name: Achiacharus
people.description: "Achiacharus my brother Anael's son", cupbearer and keeper of the signet to Sarchedonus, who nourished Tobit; Aman handled him evil, yet he was saved (Tobit 1:21-22, 2:10, 11:18, 14:10)

father.note: "Achiacharus my brother Anael's son"

people.name: Anael
people.description: Tobit's brother, father of Achiacharus (Tobit 1:21)

siblings.note: "my brother Anael"

children.note: "Achiacharus my brother Anael's son"

people.name: Sarchedonus
people.description: The son of Sennacherib, who reigned in his stead after two of his sons killed him; he set Achiacharus over his father's accounts (Tobit 1:21-22)

father.note: "Sarchedonus his son reigned in his stead"

same.note: In the same place: after Sennacherib's two sons killed him and fled, "Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead" (2 Kings 19:37), "Sarchedonus his son reigned in his stead" (Tobit 1:21)

people.name: Raguel
people.description: Of Ecbatane in Media, Tobit's cousin, father of Sara, who gave her to Tobias (Tobit 3:7, 6:10, 7:1-16)

people.name: Sara
people.description: The only daughter of Raguel and Edna, whose seven husbands Asmodeus had killed; given to Tobias to wife (Tobit 3:7-15, 6:10-12, 7:11-13)

partners.note: "gave her to be wife to Tobias"

people.name: Asmodeus
people.description: "Asmodeus the evil spirit", who killed Sara's seven husbands; he fled into the utmost parts of Egypt, and the angel bound him (Tobit 3:8, 3:17, 8:3)

people.name: Raphael
people.description: The angel sent to heal Tobit and to give Sara to Tobias; he called himself "Azarias, the son of Ananias the great", and at the end said, "I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels" (Tobit 3:17, 5:4-13, 12:15)

people.name: Ananias
people.description: "Ananias the great", the son of "that great Samaias", whom Tobit knew (Tobit 5:12-13)

father.note: "Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias"

siblings.note: "Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias"

people.name: Jonathas
people.description: The son of "that great Samaias", whom Tobit knew (Tobit 5:13)

father.note: "Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias"

siblings.note: "Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias"

people.name: Samaias
people.description: "That great Samaias", father of Ananias and Jonathas (Tobit 5:13)

children.note: "Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias"
"Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias"

people.name: Edna
people.description: The wife of Raguel, mother of Sara (Tobit 7:2, 7:8, 10:12)

people.name: Nasbas
people.description: Who came with Achiacharus to Tobias' wedding, "his brother's son" (Tobit 11:18)

people.name: Aman
people.description: Who "handled Achiacharus that brought him up", but "fell into the snare, and perished" (Tobit 14:10)

people.name: Manasses
people.description: Who "gave alms, and escaped the snares of death which they had set for him" (Tobit 14:10)

people.name: Assuerus
people.description: Who with Nabuchodonosor took Nineve (Tobit 14:15)

people.name: Arphaxad
people.description: "Arphaxad, which reigned over the Medes in Ecbatane", overthrown by Nabuchodonosor (Judith 1:1-15)

people.name: Nabuchodonosor
people.description: "Nabuchodonosor, who reigned in Nineve, the great city", "king of the Assyrians", who made war with Arphaxad and sent Holofernes against the west (Judith 1:1, 1:7, 2:1-4)

people.name: Arioch
people.description: "Arioch the king of the Elymeans" (Judith 1:6)

people.name: Chelod
people.description: "Very many nations of the sons of Chelod" (Judith 1:6)

people.name: Elymeans
people.description: Whose king was Arioch (Judith 1:6)

people.name: Holofernes
people.description: "The chief captain of his army, which was next unto him", sent by Nabuchodonosor against the west; Judith smote off his head in his tent (Judith 2:4, 13:6-9)

people.name: Chellians
people.description: "The land of the Chellians" (Judith 2:23)

people.name: Rasses
people.description: "All the children of Rasses", spoiled by Holofernes with "the children of Ismael" (Judith 2:23)

people.name: Joacim
people.description: "Joacim the high priest, which was in those days in Jerusalem" (Judith 4:6, 4:8, 4:14, 15:8)

people.name: Achior
people.description: "The captain of all the sons of Ammon", who told Holofernes of Israel; he was given to the children of Israel, believed in God and was circumcised (Judith 5:5-21, 6:10-13, 14:10)

nation.note: "Achior, the captain of all the sons of Ammon"; "Achior the Ammonite"

people.name: Sychemite
people.description: Cast out before Israel with the Chanaanite, the Pherezite and the Jebusite (Judith 5:16)

people.name: Chabris
people.description: "Chabris the son of Gothoniel", one of the governors of Bethulia (Judith 6:15, 8:10, 10:6)

people.name: Charmis
people.description: "Charmis the son of Melchiel", one of the governors of Bethulia (Judith 6:15, 8:10, 10:6)

people.name: Gothoniel
people.description: The father of Chabris (Judith 6:15)

people.name: Melchiel
people.description: The father of Charmis (Judith 6:15)

people.name: Micha
people.description: The father of Ozias (Judith 6:15)

people.name: Ozias
people.description: "Ozias the son of Micha, of the tribe of Simeon", a governor of Bethulia (Judith 6:15, 8:10, 15:4)

people.name: Acitho
people.description: In the line of Judith, the son of Eliu, father of Raphaim (Judith 8:1)

people.name: Ananias
people.description: In the line of Judith, the son of Gedeon, father of Elcia (Judith 8:1)

people.name: Elcia
people.description: In the line of Judith, the son of Ananias, father of Oziel (Judith 8:1)

people.name: Eliab
people.description: In the line of Judith, the son of Nathanael, father of Eliu (Judith 8:1)

people.name: Eliu
people.description: In the line of Judith, the son of Eliab, father of Acitho (Judith 8:1)

people.name: Gedeon
people.description: In the line of Judith, the son of Raphaim, father of Ananias (Judith 8:1)

people.name: Joseph
people.description: In the line of Judith, the son of Oziel (Judith 8:1)

people.name: Judith
people.description: "The daughter of Merari", a widow of Bethulia, who went out to Holofernes and smote off his head; she lived an hundred and five years (Judith 8:1-8, 13:6-10, 16:23)

partners.note: "Manasses was her husband, of her tribe and kindred"

tribe.note: "O Lord God of my father Simeon"

people.name: Merari
people.description: The father of Judith, "the son of Ox, the son of Joseph" (Judith 8:1, 16:7)

line.note: "Merari, the son of Ox, the son of Joseph"; Ox has no record because the word is also a common noun in the KJV

people.name: Nathanael
people.description: In the line of Judith, the son of Samael, father of Eliab (Judith 8:1)

people.name: Oziel
people.description: In the line of Judith, the son of Elcia, father of Joseph (Judith 8:1)

people.name: Raphaim
people.description: In the line of Judith, the son of Acitho, father of Gedeon (Judith 8:1)

people.name: Salasadai
people.description: In the line of Judith: "the son of Salasadai, the son of Israel" (Judith 8:1)

line.note: "the son of Salasadai, the son of Israel"

people.name: Samael
people.description: In the line of Judith, the son of Salasadai, father of Nathanael (Judith 8:1)

people.name: Manasses
people.description: Judith's husband, "of her tribe and kindred, who died in the barley harvest" in Bethulia (Judith 8:2-3, 8:7, 16:22-24)

partners.note: "Manasses was her husband, of her tribe and kindred"

people.name: Bagoas
people.description: "Bagoas the eunuch, who had charge over all that he had", Holofernes' servant (Judith 12:11-15, 13:1-3, 14:14)

people.name: Titans
people.description: "Neither did the sons of the Titans smite him, nor high giants set upon him" (Judith 16:7)

people.name: Cleopatra
people.description: Named with Ptolemeus in the dating of the epistle of Phurim (Esther 11:1)

people.name: Dositheus
people.description: "Who said he was a priest and Levite", who with Ptolemeus his son brought the epistle of Phurim (Esther 11:1)

children.note: "Dositheus ... and Ptolemeus his son"

people.name: Lysimachus
people.description: "The son of Ptolemeus, that was in Jerusalem", who had interpreted the epistle of Phurim (Esther 11:1)

father.note: "Lysimachus the son of Ptolemeus"

people.name: Ptolemeus
people.description: The king, "in the fourth year of the reign of Ptolemeus and Cleopatra", when the epistle of Phurim was brought (Esther 11:1)

people.name: Ptolemeus
people.description: The son of Dositheus, who with his father brought the epistle of Phurim (Esther 11:1)

father.note: "Dositheus ... and Ptolemeus his son"

people.name: Ptolemeus
people.description: The father of Lysimachus (Esther 11:1)

children.note: "Lysimachus the son of Ptolemeus"

people.name: Artaxerxes
people.description: "Artaxerxes the great", the king of Mardocheus and Esther, who wrote "unto the princes and governors of an hundred and seven and twenty provinces from India unto Ethiopia" (Esther 11:2, 13:1, 16:1)

same.note: The same king and the same realm: "Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even unto Ethiopia, over an hundred and seven and twenty provinces" (Esther 1:1); "The great king Artaxerxes unto the princes and governors of an hundred and seven and twenty provinces from India unto Ethiopia" (Esther 16:1), both the king of Mordecai and Esther

people.name: Gabatha
people.description: One of "the two eunuchs of the king, and keepers of the palace", whose purpose to lay hands on the king Mardocheus made known (Esther 12:1-3)

same.note: The same plot: "two of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door ... sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus", told by Mordecai (Esther 2:21-22); "Gabatha and Tharra, the two eunuchs of the king, and keepers of the palace"; Mardocheus "learned that they were about to lay hands upon Artaxerxes the king; and so he certified the king of them" (Esther 12:1-2)

people.name: Tharra
people.description: One of "the two eunuchs of the king, and keepers of the palace", whose purpose to lay hands on the king Mardocheus made known (Esther 12:1-3)

same.note: The same plot: "two of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door ... sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus", told by Mordecai (Esther 2:21-22); "Gabatha and Tharra, the two eunuchs of the king, and keepers of the palace"; Mardocheus "learned that they were about to lay hands upon Artaxerxes the king; and so he certified the king of them" (Esther 12:1-2)

people.name: Tyrians
people.description: "He destroyed the rulers of the Tyrians, and all the princes of the Philistines" (Ecclesiasticus 46:18)

people.name: Onias
people.description: The father of Simon the high priest (Ecclesiasticus 50:1)

people.name: Simon
people.description: "Simon the high priest, the son of Onias, who in his life repaired the house again, and in his days fortified the temple" (Ecclesiasticus 50:1-21)

people.name: Jesus
people.description: "Jesus the son of Sirach of Jerusalem", who "hath written in this book the instruction of understanding and knowledge" (Ecclesiasticus 50:27)

people.name: Sirach
people.description: The father of Jesus, who wrote the book (Ecclesiasticus 50:27)
